title: My Salah and Masjid
intro: Ten evidence-grounded remembrances that help children move from hearing the Adhan to preparing for Salah, remembering Allah in its different positions, and praising Him afterward.

lessons.title: Answering the Call With Faith
lessons.tagline: VOLUME 04 / PROPHETIC REMEMBRANCE CONNECTED TO THE ADHAN / BELONGING AND WILLINGNESS TO PRAY

words.text: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا
Ashhadu an lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh. Raḍītu billāhi rabban, wa bi-Muḥammadin rasūlan, wa bil-Islāmi dīnā.

words.label: English meaning
words.text: I testify that none is worthy of worship except Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Muhammad as Messenger, and Islam as my religion.
میں گواہی دیتا ہوں کہ اللہ کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں، وہ اکیلا ہے، اس کا کوئی شریک نہیں؛ اور محمد ﷺ اس کے بندے اور رسول ہیں۔ میں اللہ کے رب ہونے، محمد ﷺ کے رسول ہونے اور اسلام کے دین ہونے پر راضی ہوں۔

words.label: When to use it
words.text: When hearing the mu’adhdhin (the call to Salah); learn the response to the Adhan in addition to this phrase.

story: The sound of the Adhan reached the family while Imaan was arranging her schoolbooks and Akhlaq was choosing a game. They both paused. “This is the call to remember Allah and prepare for Salah,” Salaam explained. Akhlaq was curious about what the words meant, so they listened quietly together. Dadi Jaan helped them practise a special testimony taught for hearing the Adhan. She also explained that we answer the call by repeating the mu’adhdhin’s words, with a different response at the invitation to prayer. Instead of treating the Adhan like background noise, the children decided to give it their attention.
understand: The Adhan calls Muslims to prayer. In this authentic remembrance, we affirm Allah’s oneness, the message of Muhammad ﷺ, and our satisfaction with Islam. This is a longer lesson; begin with “Raḍītu billāhi rabban” if a child needs a gentle starting point, but show the full text as the learning target. Other responses to the Adhan are also part of the Sunnah and must be taught accurately. The app should guide a child without claiming that saying the phrase alone replaces getting ready for Salah.

lessons.title: A Beautiful Du’a After the Adhan
lessons.tagline: VOLUME 04 / PROPHETIC SUPPLICATION AFTER THE ADHAN / LOVE FOR THE PROPHET ﷺ AND ATTENTION TO WORSHIP

words.text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
Allāhumma Rabba hādhihi-d-daʿwati-t-tāmmah waṣ-ṣalāti-l-qā’imah, āti Muḥammadan al-wasīlata wal-faḍīlah, wabʿathhu maqāman maḥmūdan alladhī waʿadtah.

words.label: English meaning
words.text: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad the Wasīlah and special honour, and raise him to the praised station You promised him.
اے اللہ! اس کامل دعوت اور قائم ہونے والی نماز کے رب! محمد ﷺ کو وسیلہ اور فضیلت عطا فرما اور انہیں وہ مقامِ محمود عطا فرما جس کا تو نے ان سے وعدہ کیا ہے۔

words.label: When to use it
words.text: After the Adhan ends; also teach sending blessings on the Prophet ﷺ in the appropriate sequence, as mentioned in Sahih Muslim 384.

words.label: Primary evidence
words.text: Sahih al-Bukhari 614  |  Sahih
https://sunnah.com/bukhari:614

lessons.occasion: After the Adhan ends; also teach sending blessings on the Prophet ﷺ in the appropriate sequence, as mentioned in Sahih Muslim 384.
story: One evening, Imaan heard the Adhan while she was helping Salamah tidy the table. She wanted to learn something more than simply recognising its sound. Dadi Jaan explained that after the call to prayer there is a beautiful supplication for Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Akhlaq tried to remember the first part, but the sentence felt long. “We can learn one meaningful piece today,” Imaan said. Their father played a careful recitation, then waited while each child repeated a short section. The children were pleased that learning slowly still meant making progress. At the next Adhan, they recognised the opening words without needing a reminder.
understand: This Du’a asks Allah to grant Prophet Muhammad ﷺ the Wasīlah, special virtue, and the praised station promised to him. It teaches love, respect, and the value of listening to the call for prayer. The narration reports a special virtue for saying it; the game must not convert that spiritual promise into a digital trophy. Use the precise selected source version. Unlike a short Dhikr, this lesson may be revisited many times before the child recalls it confidently.

lessons.tagline: VOLUME 04 / PROPHETIC REMEMBRANCE AFTER COMPLETING WUDU / CLEANLINESS, PREPARATION AND SINCERITY

words.text: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ
Ashhadu an lā ilāha illallāh, wa anna Muḥammadan ʿabdullāhi wa rasūluh.

میں گواہی دیتا ہوں کہ اللہ کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں اور محمد ﷺ اللہ کے بندے اور اس کے رسول ہیں۔

words.label: When to use it
words.text: After completing Wudu properly.

words.label: Primary evidence

https://sunnah.com/muslim:234a

lessons.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ

lessons.english: I testify that none is worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is Allah’s servant and Messenger.
lessons.urdu: میں گواہی دیتا ہوں کہ اللہ کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں اور محمد ﷺ اللہ کے بندے اور اس کے رسول ہیں۔
story: Akhlaq returned from the playground and wanted to join the family for prayer. He hurried toward the wash area. Imaan reminded him that being ready for Salah includes taking care with Wudu, not just splashing water quickly. Salaam guided him through the necessary steps. When Akhlaq finished, his father taught him the testimony reported after Wudu. Imaan said it slowly so he could hear the words clearly. Akhlaq understood that the next step was not to celebrate how fast he had finished but to approach prayer calmly. He folded his towel and left the wash area tidy for the next person.
understand: Wudu prepares us for Salah. After completing it, the Prophet ﷺ taught words affirming belief in Allah and His Messenger. We should learn both correct Wudu and the remembrance that follows. The spoken formula is not a replacement for washing properly. Children can memorise it by connecting the first testimony to the second, then saying them together. The app may show Wudu scenes, but exact legal steps and school-of-law details should be approved by a qualified teacher.

lessons.title: Beginning Salah With a Clean Heart
lessons.tagline: VOLUME 04 / PROPHETIC OPENING SUPPLICATION IN SALAH / HONEST REPENTANCE AND STARTING WELL

words.text: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ

Allāhumma bāʿid baynī wa bayna khaṭāyāya kamā bāʿadta bayna-l-mashriqi wa-l-maghrib; Allāhumma naqqinī mina-l-khaṭāyā kamā yunaqqa-th-thawbu-l-abyaḍu mina-d-danas; Allāhumma-ghsil khaṭāyāya bi-l-mā’i wa-th-thalji wa-l-barad.

words.label: English meaning
words.text: O Allah, keep me far from my sins as You have separated the east and west. Purify me of sins as a white garment is cleaned of dirt. Wash away my sins with water, snow and hail.
اے اللہ! میرے اور میری خطاؤں کے درمیان اتنا فاصلہ کر دے جتنا مشرق و مغرب میں ہے۔ مجھے گناہوں سے اس طرح پاک کر جیسے سفید کپڑا میل سے پاک کیا جاتا ہے۔ میری خطاؤں کو پانی، برف اور اولوں سے دھو دے۔

words.label: When to use it
words.text: After the opening Takbir and before Qur’an recitation in Salah; an authentic opening-supplication option.

words.label: Primary evidence

lessons.urdu: اے اللہ! میرے اور میری خطاؤں کے درمیان اتنا فاصلہ کر دے جتنا مشرق و مغرب میں ہے۔ مجھے گناہوں سے اس طرح پاک کر جیسے سفید کپڑا میل سے پاک کیا جاتا ہے۔ میری خطاؤں کو پانی، برف اور اولوں سے دھو دے۔
lessons.occasion: After the opening Takbir and before Qur’an recitation in Salah; an authentic opening-supplication option.
story: Akhlaq had spoken impatiently to his sister before prayer. He felt uncomfortable even after he apologised. Imaan told him that a good beginning includes making things right with people and asking Allah for forgiveness. Salaam then introduced one authentic supplication the Prophet ﷺ said near the beginning of Salah. Its picture of cleaning a white cloth helped the children understand the idea of purification. They practised just the opening phrase and listened to the whole Du’a. Neither child was expected to learn it immediately. What mattered was approaching Allah with sincerity and a willingness to improve.
understand: A believer asks Allah to remove wrong actions and purify the heart. This opening Du’a has a powerful image of a clean white garment. The Prophet ﷺ used it after the opening Takbir, before reciting Qur’an. Other authentic opening supplications also exist, so children should not criticise someone who uses a different established option. The words are long and should be taught in meaningful units. In practical life, seeking forgiveness goes with trying to repair a wrong and choosing better behaviour next time.

lessons.title: Remembering Allah in Ruku
lessons.tagline: VOLUME 04 / PROPHETIC REMEMBRANCE IN BOWING / HUMILITY AND RESPECT

words.text: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
Subḥāna Rabbiyal-ʿAẓīm

words.label: English meaning
words.text: Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent.
پاک ہے میرا رب جو عظمت والا ہے۔

words.label: When to use it
words.text: During Ruku (bowing) in Salah.

words.label: Primary evidence
words.text: Sunan Abi Dawud 871  |  Sahih (al-Albani)
https://sunnah.com/abudawud:871

lessons.english: Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent.
lessons.urdu: پاک ہے میرا رب جو عظمت والا ہے۔
story: During a family lesson on Salah, Imaan practised the words said in Ruku while an adult demonstrated the posture. Akhlaq wondered why the phrase was so short. Dadi Jaan explained that a small group of words can carry a very big meaning. We recognise the greatness of Allah and remember that we are His servants. Akhlaq repeated the phrase slowly, paying attention to each letter. Later, when he helped a younger cousin find a lost pencil, he remembered that real humility also means not looking down on other people. His words during prayer and his actions afterward could support each other.
understand: Ruku is a moment of humility before Allah. The words “Subḥāna Rabbiyal-ʿAẓīm” glorify our magnificent Lord. This is a short, useful phrase for children learning Salah. A careful teacher should support correct pronunciation and the appropriate bowing posture. The app must not turn Ruku into a timed exercise or encourage hurried movements for points. Repetition can be practised in the memorization screen, but devotional counts should follow the approved Salah-teaching guidance.

lessons.title: Praise After Rising From Ruku
lessons.tagline: VOLUME 04 / COMPANION’S REMEMBRANCE APPROVED BY THE PROPHET ﷺ / GRATITUDE EXPRESSED BEAUTIFULLY

words.text: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
Rabbanā wa lakal-ḥamd, ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh.

words.label: English meaning
words.text: Our Lord, to You belongs praise—abundant, good, and blessed praise.
اے ہمارے رب! تمام تعریف تیرے ہی لیے ہے، بہت زیادہ، پاکیزہ اور بابرکت تعریف۔

words.label: When to use it
words.text: Upon standing upright after Ruku in Salah, in its appropriate place.

words.label: Primary evidence
words.text: Sahih al-Bukhari 799  |  Sahih
https://sunnah.com/bukhari:799

lessons.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ
lessons.transliteration: Rabbanā wa lakal-ḥamd, ḥamdan kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh.
lessons.english: Our Lord, to You belongs praise—abundant, good, and blessed praise.
lessons.urdu: اے ہمارے رب! تمام تعریف تیرے ہی لیے ہے، بہت زیادہ، پاکیزہ اور بابرکت تعریف۔
lessons.occasion: Upon standing upright after Ruku in Salah, in its appropriate place.
story: Imaan noticed that some moments in Salah include praise while others include a request for help. Salaam showed the children an authentic report about a Companion who said wonderful words of praise after rising from Ruku. The Prophet ﷺ approved of those words. Akhlaq liked learning the history behind the phrase. “So we must be accurate about who said it,” he observed. Dadi Jaan agreed. They tried the shorter opening and gradually added the rest. That afternoon Imaan thanked Salamah for helping her organise her homework, realising that gratitude should also appear in everyday speech.
understand: This remembrance offers abundant, good and blessed praise to Allah. In the report in Sahih al-Bukhari, the words came from a Companion and were approved by the Prophet ﷺ. That distinction matters: Islamic learning should tell the story faithfully. The child can begin with the first phrase, then extend it. As they learn, adults should explain where standing after Ruku fits within Salah, rather than presenting every remembered phrase as interchangeable during prayer.

With a calm adult demonstration, the children learnt the words “Subḥāna Rabbiyal-Aʿlā.” Imaan noticed how the words differed from the Ruku remembrance, though both glorified Allah. understand: During Sujud we say “Subḥāna Rabbiyal-Aʿlā,” glorifying our Lord, the Most High. story: The children were revising the order of Salah with their teacher. Akhlaq remembered standing, bowing and prostrating, but he was uncertain about the sitting between the two Sujuds. The teacher showed him the sequence and taught a gentle, short supplication asking Allah for forgiveness. “These words are easy to hear but important to mean,” Imaan said. At home, Akhlaq remembered a time he had blamed another child unfairly. He spoke to his parents about apologising. understand: The Du’a “Rabbi-ghfir lī” is a direct request: “My Lord, forgive me.” The cited report repeats the phrase while sitting between the two prostrations. When learning this in Salah, children must know the correct place for it, not only the Arabic words. We can also explain that forgiveness includes turning away from a wrong and repairing harm where possible. The app should teach a gentle self-check, never shame children or require them to disclose private mistakes.

story: After prayer, Akhlaq was ready to dash off to his toys. Dadi Jaan asked whether he knew that there are remembrances we can say after Salah. Imaan already knew “Subḥānallāh” and “Al-ḥamdu lillāh,” but she did not know how they could be joined in one authentic sequence. Salaam showed them a small counter with no loud sounds or flashing rewards. They practised slowly, remembering that the counts belonged to this particular reported form. When Akhlaq lost count, he simply started his practice again without frustration. The children discovered that a few calm moments after prayer could become a pleasant habit.
understand: The Prophet ﷺ taught specific remembrances following Salah. In this authentic report, each of three phrases is said thirty-three times, followed by the longer statement of Allah’s oneness to complete one hundred. Children may initially practise without attempting the whole sequence independently. Unlike normal study repetitions, these numbers belong to the sourced religious practice. The app must keep the actual devotional sequence distinct from optional learning replay, and support other authenticated post-Salah forms when approved.
